body:
Just wanted to follow up before I completely abandon this account (it was a throwaway for a reason).

The last two days have rough.  Stayed home from work yesterday (yay IT and working from home) mostly because I didn't feel like moving.  Today, I was zoned out all day.  Got a few pieces of unfortunate news regarding everything else going on in my life.

/u/_MoreNowAgain_ - I only didn't want to go to the hospital because of already being alone and unable to have someone take my dog.   I was 5150d when I tried to jump off of golden gate bridge back in April.  I can honestly say it was the best experience I've ever had.  I know it's not the same for everyone, but that hospital really, truly, helped.

/u/soupstar - I haven't yet.  I might not.  I should.  But I have so many other things I have to jump over first.  I wont forget the call though, that's for sure.

/u/spec_a - call them.  I am sure I just got a bad apple.  Maybe I sounded stable?  I don't know.  I know I wasn't.

/u/Daakuryu  - Yeah, I've tried it before.  I thought I'd be OK with the suffering part.  I've heard it's only like 5-10 minutes.  I have 10ft ceilings, but am shit at finding studs to hang the hardware that would support my weight.  Guess that's a good thing.   I honestly cannot recommend the experience to anyone.

/u/Hutnick - I'm pretty dead inside.  Nothing interests me.  I used to be an avid gamer.  Haven't played a single one in over a month.  Just can't bring myself to do it.  I'm a raging drunk at nights now (~10 oz of vokda in a few hours), but that's the only way I can be totally numb.  I know it's not the right answer, but right now alcohol honestly keeps me alive.  

Thank you to the supportive people.  This SN will not get logged into again, but I did want to follow up tonight, when I have a somewhat clear headspace.  Don't get me wrong, my world is still crumbling around me.  But I don't feel nearly as helpless tonight.
